synth.notes:
Mirror axes: horizontal wall band at row R and vertical band at col C, on a 3x3-block grid. Pieces are holed 3x3 blocks. ACTION5 cycles the selection H-axis -> V-axis -> pieces; actions 1-4 move the selected item by 3 cells.
Gray reflections are the pieces mirrored across C. Pieces and gray mirrored across R become invisible layer-3 erasers: they hide targets and use up reflection name indices.
Holes show the first solid pixel below them. Otherwise they show fill 0 for a selected wall/piece, and fill 4 for a reflection only when it is the top sprite.
Targets are 4-connected components, merged repeatedly while their bounding boxes are within 4 cells of each other. Wall names count non-wall 0 pixels.
Unconfirmed: eraser vs gray layer order, whether pieces block each other, axis bounds, and whether ACTION5 really selects the V-axis (no transition required it).
